description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/au-reseed-ladder: the increment 5 was not observed (only one insert followed the reseed) and no public read between steps (only the whole-file hash existed for the middle steps). AutoNumber reseed: Au1 (ten rows) receives ALTER TABLE Au1 ALTER COLUMN ID COUNTER(200, 5) with dbFailOnError (the key column is the primary key; a refusal is an observation); then two inserts without an ID, each as its own step, whose IDs are read by @@IDENTITY. Asks what the file shows after each step, which ID the first insert gets and how far the second one advances; the table is read back after every step. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
